arxiv-1810-08279.title: A Comparison of the Trojan Y Chromosome Strategy to Harvesting Models for Eradication of Non-Native Species
arxiv-1810-08279.description: Abstract . The Trojan Y Chromosome Strategy (TYC) is a promising eradication method for biological control of non-native species. The strategy works by manipulating the sex ratio of a population through the introduction of supermales that guarantee male offspring. In the current manuscript, we compare the TYC method with a pure harvesting strategy.

arxiv-2107-13460.title: The number of n n -queens configurations
arxiv-2107-13460.creator: Michael Simkin
arxiv-2107-13460.description: Abstract . The n n -queens problem is to determine 𝒬 ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{Q}(n) , the number of ways to place n n mutually non-threatening queens on an n × n n\times n board. We show that there exists a constant α = 1.942 ± 3 × 10 − 3 \alpha=1.

arxiv-2109-07382.title: Toward Modern Fortran Tooling and a Thriving Developer Community
arxiv-2109-07382.creator: Milan Curcic, Ondřej Čertík, Brad Richardson, Sebastian Ehlert, Laurence Kedward, Arjen Markus, Ivan Pribec, Jérémie Vandenplas
arxiv-2109-07382.description: Abstract Fortran is the oldest high-level programming language that remains in use today and is one of the dominant languages used for compute-intensive scientific and engineering applications. However, Fortran has not kept up with the modern software development practices and tooling in the internet era. As a consequence, the Fortran developer experience has diminished.

arxiv-2202-13497.title: Zariski dense orbits for endomorphisms of a power of the additive group scheme defined over finite fields
arxiv-2202-13497.creator: Dragos Ghioca, Sina Saleh
arxiv-2202-13497.description: Abstract . We prove the Zariski dense orbit conjecture in positive characteristic for endomorphisms of 𝔾 a N {\mathbb{G}}_{a}^{N} defined over 𝔽 p ¯ \overline{\mathbb{F}_{p}} . 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 14K15, Secondary 14G05 1. Introduction 1.1. Notation We let {\mathbb{N}}_{0}:={\mathbb{N}}\cup\{0\} denote the set of nonnegative integers.

arxiv-2211-11033.title: On the Complexity of Bayesian Generalization
arxiv-2211-11033.creator: Yu-Zhe Shi, Manjie Xu, John E. Hopcroft, Kun He, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Song-Chun Zhu, Ying Nian Wu, Wenjuan Han, Yixin Zhu
arxiv-2211-11033.description: Abstract We consider concept generalization at a large scale in the diverse and natural visual spectrum. Established computational modes ( i.e . , rule-based or similarity-based) are primarily studied isolated and focus on confined and abstract problem spaces. In this work, we study these two modes when the problem space scales up, and the complexity of concepts becomes diverse.

arxiv-2302-08724.title: Piecewise Deterministic Markov Processes for Bayesian Neural Networks
arxiv-2302-08724.creator: Ethan Goan, Dimitri Perrin, Kerrie Mengersen, Clinton Fookes
arxiv-2302-08724.description: Abstract Inference on modern Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) often relies on a variational inference treatment, imposing violated assumptions of independence and the form of the posterior. Traditional MCMC approaches avoid these assumptions at the cost of increased computation due to its incompatibility to subsampling of the likelihood.

arxiv-2304-04854.title: iPINNs: Incremental learning for Physics-informed neural networks
arxiv-2304-04854.creator: Aleksandr Dekhovich, Marcel H.F. Sluiter, David M.J. Tax, Miguel A. Bessa
arxiv-2304-04854.description: Abstract Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have recently become a powerful tool for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, finding a set of neural network parameters that lead to fulfilling a PDE can be challenging and non-unique due to the complexity of the loss landscape that needs to be traversed.

arxiv-2403-02287.title: Note on the spectra of Steiner distance hypermatrices
arxiv-2403-02287.creator: Joshua Cooper, Zhibin Du
arxiv-2403-02287.description: Abstract The Steiner distance of a set of vertices in a graph is the fewest number of edges in any connected subgraph containing those vertices. The order- k k Steiner distance hypermatrix of a graph is the n n -dimensional array indexed by vertices, whose entries are the Steiner distances of their corresponding indices.

arxiv-2403-19364.title: Quantum Liang Information Flow Probe of Causality Across Critical Points
arxiv-2403-19364.creator: Roopayan Ghosh, Bin Yi, Sougato Bose
arxiv-2403-19364.description: Abstract Investigating causation in the quantum domain is crucial. Despite numerous studies of correlations in quantum many-body systems, causation, which is very distinct from correlations, has hardly been studied. We address this by demonstrating the efficacy of the newly established causation measure, quantum Liang information flow, in quantifying causality across phase diagrams of quantum many-body systems.

arxiv-2407-13281.title: Auditing Local Explanations is Hard
arxiv-2407-13281.creator: Robi Bhattacharjee, Ulrike von Luxburg
arxiv-2407-13281.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Robi Bhattacharjee, Ulrike von Luxburg. In sensitive contexts, providers of machine learning algorithms are increasingly required to give explanations for their algorithms’ decisions. However, explanation receivers might not trust the provider, who potentially could output misleading or manipulated explanations. In this work, we investigate an auditing framework in which a third-party auditor or a collective of users attempts to sanity-check explanations: they can query model decisions and the corresponding local explanations, pool all the information received, and then check for basic consistency properties.

arxiv-2506-00241.title: Designing AI Tools for Clinical Care Teams to Support Serious Illness Conversations with Older Adults in the Emergency Department CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI CCS: Applied computing Health care information systems CCS: Computing methodologies Artificial intelligence
arxiv-2506-00241.creator: Menglin Zhao, Zhuorui Yong, Ruijia Guan, Kai-Wei Chang, Adrian Haimovich, Kei Ouchi, Timothy Bickmore, Bingsheng Yao, Dakuo Wang, Smit Desai
arxiv-2506-00241.description: Abstract . Serious illness conversations (SICs), discussions between clinical care teams and patients with serious, life-limiting illnesses about their values, goals, and care preferences, are critical for patient-centered care. Without these conversations, patients often receive aggressive interventions that may not align with their goals.

arxiv-2510-07692.title: Hybrid CNN-BYOL Approach for Fault Detection in Induction Motors Using Thermal Images
arxiv-2510-07692.creator: Tangin Amir Smrity 1, MD Zahin Muntaqim 1 Hasan Muhammad Kafi 1, Abu Saleh Musa Miah 2, Najmul Hassan 2, Yuichi Okuyama 2, Nobuyoshi Asai 2, Taro Suzuki 2, Jungpil Shin* 2
arxiv-2510-07692.description: Abstract Induction motors (IMs) are indispensable in industrial and daily life, but they are susceptible to various faults that can lead to overheating, wasted energy consumption, and service failure. Early detection of faults is essential to protect the motor and prolong its lifespan.

europmc-pmc4517124.title: Tissue Barriers to Arbovirus Infection in Mosquitoes.
europmc-pmc4517124.creator: Franz AW, Kantor AM, Passarelli AL, Clem RJ.
europmc-pmc4517124.description: Arthropod-borne viruses (arboviruses) circulate in nature between arthropod vectors and vertebrate hosts. Arboviruses often cause devastating diseases in vertebrate hosts, but they typically do not cause significant pathology in their arthropod vectors. Following oral...

pmc-11458765.title: Two-dimensional coordination risedronate-manganese nanobelts as adjuvant for cancer radiotherapy and immunotherapy
pmc-11458765.creator: Zhusheng Huang, Shiqian Huang, Simin Song, Yankui Ding, Hao Zhou, Shaoyin Zhang, Lixing Weng, Ying Zhang, Yiqiao Hu, Ahu Yuan, Yunlu Dai, Zhimin Luo, Lianhui Wang
pmc-11458765.description: The irradiated tumor itself represents an opportunity to establish endogenous in situ vaccines. However, such in situ cancer vaccination (ISCV) triggered by radiation therapy (RT) alone is very weak and hardly elicits systemic anticancer immunity. In this study, we develop two-dimensional risedronate-manganese nanobelts (RMn-NBs) as an adjuvant for RT to address this issue.

pmc-11605350.title: Construct validity of primary trait writing rubrics based on assessment use argument (AUA) validation framework
pmc-11605350.creator: Nurul Fariena Asli, Mohd Effendi Ewan Mohd Matore, Melor Md Yunus
pmc-11605350.description: In assessing performance-based language assessment, the use of a valid and reliable scoring rubric is crucial to minimize measurement errors that become threats in the rating process. The validation process of rubrics which previously was based on qualitative data is not satisfying since empirical evidence is not present.

pmc-11656754.title: Individual psychological interventions and therapies for posttraumatic stress disorder and posttraumatic stress symptoms in young children: a systematic review
pmc-11656754.creator: Nina Moner, Andrea Soubelet, Philippine Villard, Florence Askenazy
pmc-11656754.description: Context: Treatments for posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) in young children (ages 0–6) should be adapted to their developmental characteristics: to their cognitive, social, and emotional abilities, to their specific trauma reactions and adjustments, and finally, to their degree of dependency on adults.

pmc-12474049.title: Bridging the Gap: Two Decades of Childhood Vaccination Coverage and Equity in Cambodia and the Philippines (2000–2022)
pmc-12474049.creator: Yanqin Zhang, Xinyu Zhang, Qian Long, Zixin Wang
pmc-12474049.description: Background/Objectives: Equitable access to childhood vaccines remains a challenge in many low- and middle-income countries. This study assessed coverage of WHO-recommended childhood vaccines in Cambodia and the Philippines, focusing on urban–rural and wealth disparities, and examined maternal demographic and socioeconomic factors influencing vaccination coverage.

pmc-12700418.title: Physician-physician handover from acute care to rehabilitation setting: A scoping review protocol
pmc-12700418.creator: Seungjae Cho, Nancy Xi, Emma A. Bateman, Cynthia Chui, Eric Poon, Aran Bains, Patrick Fangping Yao, Meiqi Guo
pmc-12700418.description: ObjectiveThe purpose of this scoping review is to map the existing evidence that describes strategies to improve handover from the acute care to rehabilitation settings.IntroductionPoor handover processes have been associated with preventable errors, delays in care, and adverse patient outcomes. Effective physician-to-physician handover during transitions of care is critical to ensuring patient safety and optimizing clinical outcomes.

pmc-12951678.title: Narratives of recovery from persistent fatigue: a stepwise learning process
pmc-12951678.creator: Hannah Linnros, Anna Andreasson, Anna-Karin Norlin, Lars-Christer Hydén
pmc-12951678.description: Background: Persistent fatigue is a transdiagnostic symptom that is present in many different medical conditions and diagnoses and is a common reason for seeking health care. Despite a lack of consensus on how to understand and treat persistent fatigue, a subset of patients recover.

pmc-13435807.title: Unraveling yeast diversity in food fermentation using ITS1-2 amplicon-based metabarcoding
pmc-13435807.creator: Ines Pradal, Thomas Gettemans, Stefan Weckx
pmc-13435807.description: A detailed characterization of the microbial ecosystem involved in the production processes of fermented foods is essential. Although fermented foods are an important part of the human diet and have seen an increasing interest nowadays, some challenges still need to be solved. Specifically, yeast identification through culture-independent methodologies is still limited to the genus level.

pmc-13462612.title: Spatial lipid-barrier coupling in knee osteoarthritis: a mechanism-based perspective centered on the infrapatellar fat pad
pmc-13462612.creator: Yuwu Liu, Ming Chen, Ruhua Yong
pmc-13462612.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a heterogeneous whole-joint disorder in which mechanical loading, aging, metabolic stress, synovitis, microvascular dysfunction, matrix injury, subchondral remodeling, pain-related neurovascular change, and impaired repair interact over time. The infrapatellar fat pad (IFP) is increasingly recognized as an active synovio-adipose tissue, yet IFP inflammation, lipid disturbance, hypoxia, angiogenesis, matrix catabolism, and subchondral change are often considered parallel abnormalities rather than as a spatially organized propagation process.

pmc-13522109.title: When knowledge is not enough: infection prevention and control practices and occupational biological exposures among dental professionals in Zimbabwe
pmc-13522109.creator: Tanusha Singh, Kundai Mavis Makozho
pmc-13522109.description: BackgroundDental professionals are routinely exposed to occupational biological hazards, yet evidence from low-resource settings remains limited. This study assessed infection prevention and control (IPC) knowledge and practices, quantified occupational biological exposures, and identified factors associated with sharps injuries and occupational infections.MethodsA cross-sectional analytical study was conducted among 220 dental professionals in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe.

pmc-13540620.title: What Platform Scores Miss: Multidimensional Evaluation of AI Teaching Agents in Medical Education
pmc-13540620.creator: Hui Zhang, Lihui Qu, Jianmin Zheng, Yi Xiong, Hongbo Bai, Ruiying Ji, Guohui Liu, Wanling Chen, Zirui Cheng, Youbang Chen, Chun-tao Yang
pmc-13540620.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLarge language model (LLM)–based AI teaching agents are increasingly used in medical education, yet their pedagogical quality is typically judged by platform-generated scores whose scoring criteria are undisclosed and may not reflect the teaching quality of the agent.ObjectiveThis study aimed to develop and validate a multidimensional rubric for evaluating AI teaching agents and to examine the correspondence between platform scores and rubric-based teaching quality.MethodsEight AI teaching agents covering an endocrinology curriculum were deployed across 4 role-play paradigms (patient, student, expert, and family).

pmc-13556663.title: 416. Management of treatment-resistant catatonia: alternative therapeutic strategies
pmc-13556663.creator: I Martins Marques
pmc-13556663.description: BackgroundCatatonia is a severe neuropsychiatric syndrome characterized by behavioral, motor, and autonomic disturbances. It is associated with mood, psychotic disorders, encephalitis, thyroid disease, or delirium, but is often underdiagnosed, particularly in autism spectrum disorder. Its pathophysiology may involve dysregulation of GABA, dopamine, and glutamate. First-line treatment includes benzodiazepines (e.g., lorazepam) and electroconvulsive therapy.

pmc-13610264.title: Lycopene Attenuates Acute Cyclophosphamide-Induced Renal Injury in Mice: Renal Function, Cytokine Transcription, and Histopathological Evidence
pmc-13610264.creator: Elif Ece Akgun, Esra Bilici, Busra Gulbenli Turkoglu
pmc-13610264.description: Background/Objectives: Cyclophosphamide (CP) can produce acute renal toxicity through overlapping oxidative, inflammatory, and apoptotic processes. Although lycopene is widely studied for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity, its renal effects during acute CP exposure remain incompletely defined. We investigated whether a 10-day course of oral lycopene before CP administration altered early biochemical, transcriptional, histological, and apoptosis-related renal responses.
